content.text:
**Finding resubmitted: compliant** (no redline, as expected for a compliant outcome).

Repairs made to the finding:
- **Broader evidence base:** added a sweep of every "shall not" obligation in the document (only IP, confidentiality, trademark and covenant-not-to-sue restrictions appear) plus Exhibit D § 5 Personnel, alongside the earlier "solicit"/"hire"/"recruit"/"induce"/"employ" searches and full reads of §§ 10, 13 and 14.
- **Cited paragraphs widened** to p0094, p0116, p0126 and p0203 so the citation set covers each personnel- or restriction-adjacent provision reviewed, not just § 14.5.
- **Addressed the failed deterministic checks explicitly:** the absent duration limit and absent general-solicitation carve-out are artefacts of there being no restrictive covenant at all, not a deficient clause.
- **Recorded our fallback** for negotiation, should Commerce One later propose a non-solicit: mutual, 12 months, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
